approved.text:
Passenger first name: Mateo. Demo data, fictional airline Demo Air.
Flight DEMO 412 from Frankfurt (FRA) to Dubai (DXB), scheduled 2026-01-24 20:50 UTC, cancelled.
Final destination of the booking: OMDB. Ticket price 389.00 EUR.
Compensation decision: approved by the duty manager.
Travel choice: re-routing on the new flight.
Entitlements (computed by the engine):
- Compensation: 600.00 EUR, status paying, PayPal payout pending. How it was calculated: Great circle distance FRA to DXB: 4844 km (REG-7-4); 4844 km, not intra-Community: band B3, 600 EUR (REG-7-1); Duty manager approved compensation (REG-5-3)
- Meal allowance: 60.00 EUR, status paid, PayPal payout success. How it was calculated: Cancellation: meals, refreshments and two calls or e-mails are always offered (REG-5-1-B); Meals and refreshments in reasonable relation to the waiting time (REG-9-1); 60 EUR for the wait (POL-MEALS)
- Hotel, reimbursed up to: 160.00 EUR, status offered. How it was calculated: Re-routed departure the next day: hotel accommodation (REG-9-1); Cap 160 EUR per night (POL-HOTEL)
- Airport-hotel transport, reimbursed up to: 80.00 EUR, status offered. How it was calculated: Transport between the airport and the hotel (REG-9-1); Cap 40 EUR each way (POL-TRANSPORT)
- Ticket refund: not owed. Why: Passenger chose re-routing
Payment method: PayPal.
Meal, hotel and transport amounts are Demo Air policy, not set by law.

denied.text:
Passenger first name: Lucia. Demo data, fictional airline Demo Air.
Flight DEMO 218 from Milan (MXP) to Lisbon (LIS), scheduled 2026-01-22 06:40 UTC, delayed.
Final destination of the booking: LPPT. Ticket price 149.00 EUR.
Compensation decision: denied by the duty manager. Reason given: Dense freezing fog at departure with runway visual range below the reference value for the whole departure window. Rules relied on: REG-5-3, REG-REC-14. Care (meals, hotel, transport) is not affected. The passenger may contest this with the airline or the national enforcement body in the country of departure.
Entitlements (computed by the engine):
- Compensation: not owed. Why: Denied by a signed decision on extraordinary circumstances (REG-5-3)
- Meal allowance: 60.00 EUR, status paid, PayPal payout success. How it was calculated: Delay of at least 3 hours on a medium-haul flight: care (REG-6-1); Meals in reasonable relation to the waiting time (REG-9-1); 60 EUR for the wait (POL-MEALS)
Payment method: PayPal.
Meal, hotel and transport amounts are Demo Air policy, not set by law.
